main_text.p: ipse admittitur? Photium non fuisse restitutum a Ioanne, sed sola Imperatoris auctoritate ex Epistolis Michaëlis Alexandrini, & aliorum hic assufis planū est. Dixerat supra Synodus. Ε'πεῖπα δὲ παραινέσει πολλῇ [?] ὦ ἀρχαλ[?] ..., μᾶλλον ἢ τἀληθὲς εἰπεῖν, βίᾳ μεγάλῃ τῆς ὑψηλῶν, ὦ Χριστιανικωτάτων Βασιλέων ἡμῶν, ὦ σὺν τῇ βίᾳ συμφωνίᾳ ὦ ἐκκλησίᾳ τ' Κωνσταντινουπόλεως Ἐκκλησίας. Postmodum adhortatione multa & supplicatione, & vt verius dicam, vi ingenti sublimium, & Christianissimorum nostrorum Imperatorum, & ante vim illatam, consensu, precibusque Constantinopolitanæ Ecclesiæ. Sed audiatur Photius eadem Actione narrans modum, quo in thronum post mortem Ignatij restitutus est, Πάλιν πάντων συμφωνούντων, ἡ τῆς ζωῆς ἀρχιερατικῶν θεσμῶν τὰς συνοδικὰς αὐτῶν ἡμᾶς παρακαλεσάντων [?] ψῆφος, ἐπ' ᾧ καὶ τῆς ἐμπεδώσεως γραμμάτων, ὧν ὁ ἁγιώτατος Πάπας Ἰωάννης [?] ἀγαπᾷ μὲν ὦ εἰς τὸν φιλόχρηστον, καὶ ὑψηλὸν Βασιλέα ἡμῶν τὴν πᾶσαν αἴτησιν αὐτοῦ καταδέξειν ὑπομνημάτων [?] αἰνέσεως εἰς τὸν Θεὸν τῶν [?]. Verum cum omnes concordassent, & tres Patriarchales Sedes Synodicis eorundem calculis nos provocarent: nec non antea iam positis literis a sanctissimo Papa Ioanne ad Dei amantem & sublimem Imperatorem nostrum datis, quibus se omnibus illius petitionibus annuere spondet, freti in hunc thronum ascendimus. Ergo Io-

page.notes: The Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words marked [?] and the phrases after them are my best reading and should be checked against the page. The Latin is clear except for "assufis" and "sublimium", which are marked as read. The gathering signature at the foot (a small mark left of centre) is not legible and is omitted. The catchword "Io-" is printed at the lower right. Ellipsis in the Greek "ε'πεῖπα" line marks a gap I could not read, not a printed mark.
